issues.concern: Step 0 configures an 'inquiry' entry, but whether the forwarded lead's type reaches external_type at all is Q23, a step 1 question. If external_type is unset or normalises to some other key, resolveConfigFromMap falls back to DEFAULT. Then the inquiry entry governs nothing: turning it on does not enable the first text, and turning it off (A2, A20, R6) does not stop it. If ops instead turns DEFAULT on to make the test pass, every other untyped lead feed at this team starts getting STL, which is a team-wide change nobody listed.

issues.concern: Target 0 contradicts the PRD. A5 allows a 1 am forward to be 'not texted (outside window)', and the 6-hour edge case expects a stale skip.
